build_dataset_from_cfg: build a dataset from a config object supporting ConcatDataset, RepeatDataset, ClassBalancedDataset, and CBGSDataset types
build_concat_dataset: build a ConcatDataset by passing a list of dataset configs or a ConcatDataset config dict
build_repeat_dataset: build a RepeatDataset that repeats a base dataset a specified number of times
build_class_balanced_dataset: build a ClassBalancedDataset that oversamples rare classes above a given threshold
build_cbgs_dataset: build a CBGSDataset wrapper around a base dataset for cross-view grouping
